title: Moba language
description: Gur language spoken in West Africa
extract: Moba or Bimoba is a Niger-Congo language spoken by the Moba people of Togo and Ghana. There are also some Moba speakers in Burkina Faso. It has two dialects. The language cluster is also known as Moba–Bimoba.
